set: A: the site as web pages: the six pages at rest, the application with its controls on, the message page for touch devices, and the controls at their real size

issues.where: Step 3, whole page below the intro text
issues.what: at rest there is nothing to do: no start control, no Continue, no hint of what happens next - every other step has a clear way forward, and the middle two-thirds of this page is empty
issues.fix: show the assessment's control at rest (a play/start button on the device, or a queued Continue with a one-line hint) so the page has a readable next action

issues.where: the three perk cards (Unlimited PTO, Competitive Salary, Flexible Hours)
issues.what: each card has a divider rule under its one line of text and then an empty lower half; on a still page the rule promises content that is not there, so the cards read as failed to load rather than finished
issues.fix: either size the cards to their content at rest or put a resting-state line under the rule

issues.where: the headphone device, bottom right, where its tube meets the page edge
issues.what: the tube runs off the bottom edge and is cut by a diagonal tonal split at the corner; at rest it sits between deliberate 'mechanism leaving the page' and an overflow/rendering mistake
issues.fix: give the tube a clean exit (a socket or shadow at the edge) or end it inside the page

issues.where: the three dropdowns (Contact number, Date of birth, Audio volume)
issues.what: all three render completely empty - no placeholder or selected value - so at rest they read as blank boxes with chevrons rather than fields with a pending choice
issues.fix: show a placeholder or default value in each ('Select...' or the joke default for Audio volume)

issues.where: the Submit button, lower centre of Step 4
issues.what: the primary action jumps position: Continue sits bottom right on Steps 1-2, but Submit floats horizontally centred on a mostly empty page, anchored to nothing, while the verification card is top left
issues.fix: keep the primary action in the same bottom-right slot on every step, or centre the verification card with the button beneath it
